description: 统计 requests.csv 中 requests 总数。

import json

description: 读取 thresholds.conf 为结构化配置。
使用 requests.csv 和 thresholds.conf，找出 error rate 严格大于 error_rate_warn 的 service。
使用 access.log 和 thresholds.conf，统计 latency_ms 严格大于 latency_warn_ms 的请求数。
code:
import json

thresholds = {}
for line in INPUT_ARTIFACTS["data/thresholds.conf"].splitlines():
    if line:
        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        thresholds[key] = float(value) if key == "error_rate_warn" else int(value)

latency_warn_ms = thresholds["latency_warn_ms"]
lines = INPUT_ARTIFACTS["data/access.log"].splitlines()
result = sum(
    1
    for line in lines
    if line and int(line.split()[-1]) > latency_warn_ms
)
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")))

description: 对所有 fixture 生成一个最终 summary。
code:
import csv
import io
import json

request_rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(INPUT_ARTIFACTS["data/requests.csv"])))
total_requests = sum(int(row["requests"]) for row in request_rows)
api_errors = sum(
    int(row["errors"])
    for row in request_rows
    if row["service"] == "api"
)

services = json.loads(INPUT_ARTIFACTS["data/services.json"])
running_services = sum(1 for item in services if item["status"] == "running")

thresholds = {}
for line in INPUT_ARTIFACTS["data/thresholds.conf"].splitlines():
    if line:
        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        thresholds[key] = float(value) if key == "error_rate_warn" else int(value)

access_lines = [line for line in INPUT_ARTIFACTS["data/access.log"].splitlines() if line]
server_errors = sum(1 for line in access_lines if int(line.split()[-2]) >= 500)
slow_requests = sum(
    1
    for line in access_lines
    if int(line.split()[-1]) > thresholds["latency_warn_ms"]
)

result = {
    "api_errors": api_errors,
    "running_services": running_services,
    "server_errors": server_errors,
    "slow_requests": slow_requests,
    "total_requests": total_requests,
}
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")))
